title: Bronze Signal
summary: A graphic composition using a single accent mark against a deep neutral field — signal without noise.
fullDescription: Bronze Signal is a study in emphasis. One accent form carries the composition while surrounding space remains disciplined, allowing the mark to read clearly at both intimate and exhibition scale.
narrative: The work asks how a single mark can behave like a voice — clear, limited, and impossible to ignore.

story.idea: Build a graphic identity moment from one accent and an unbroken field of quiet.
story.inspiration: Wayfinding marks, radio silence before a broadcast, and bronze against charcoal stone.
story.process: The mark was redrawn until it could stand alone — no supporting ornaments, no secondary hierarchy.

processSteps.title: Mark exploration
processSteps.description: Sketched dozens of accent forms, keeping only those that read at both thumbnail and wall scale.

processSteps.title: Field discipline
processSteps.description: Tested dark grounds until the bronze mark held without glow, shadow, or decorative framing.

processSteps.title: Scale check
processSteps.description: Reviewed the composition at exhibition size to ensure the signal remained calm, not loud.

story.challenges: Resisting the urge to add supporting geometry once the mark felt lonely on the page.
story.reflection: Clarity often arrives when the design stops explaining itself.
